entities.note: solid 3x3 colour-15 square at rows 58-60, cols 3-5 (bottom-left); the only blob at L1; it is pulled to wherever you click near it
9x9 colour-9 disc at rows 11-19, cols 44-52 (top-right) with a 3x3 colour-3 centre mark at rows 14-16, cols 47-49; the blob's centre must end inside the disc's bounding box
dotted diagonal of single colour-3 pixels every 2 rows from (57,6) up to (19,45) joining the blob to the disc: a hint of the path, no collision
black right-pointing arrow glyph at rows 52-55, cols 8-11 next to the blob; disappears on the first click / once the blob leaves its start
colour-4 strip rows 0-9 with a 3x3 colour-15 icon at rows 4-6, cols 30-32 = 'one blob of this size is required'; clicks in the strip are ignored (no step cost)
row 63: black(0) = remaining steps, eaten from the RIGHT by background colour 5 as steps are spent (64 px = 32 steps, 2 px per click)

rules.note: a click whose point is within Euclidean distance 8 of the blob's bounding box pulls the blob so that its CENTRE lands on the click point (animated 4 frames, max 4 px per axis per frame): i.e. a jump of at most about 9 px per axis per click; a shrinking black ring is drawn around the click; costs 1 step
a click farther than 8 px from the blob (rows 10-62) moves nothing but still costs 1 step; clicks on rows 0-9 (HUD) or row 63 are ignored entirely and cost nothing
undo: restores the blob to where it was before the previous click; no step cost; does nothing visible if the previous click moved nothing

goal.note: the level ends the moment the colour-15 blob's centre lies inside the colour-9 disc's box (rows 11-19, cols 44-52): about +40 cols and -40 rows from the start, 7 pulls minimum within 32 steps
